# Glacia — Liquid Glass UI Kit for React & React Native

> Apple's Liquid Glass, with real refraction — not frosted blur — on web and on iOS, from one API.

## Distribution & Installation

Web (NPM package):
\`\`\`bash
npm install glacia
\`\`\`

React Native (iOS 26+):
\`\`\`bash
npm install glacia-native
\`\`\`

Glacia Copy Command (component files into your project):
\`\`\`bash
npx glacia add <component>
npx glacia add all
\`\`\`

Registry URL base:
https://glacia.dev/r/{component}.json
Full registry catalog index: https://glacia.dev/r/index.json
All-in-one bundle: https://glacia.dev/r/all.json
